name: Kasamandl
beschreibung: The Kasamandl is a traditional inn with hotel operations in the centre of Söll. The atmosphere of the house is characterised by alpine hospitality and a quiet location in the district. The guest rooms are furnished in the country-house style of Tirol. The house's typical offerings include half-board catering as well as a wellness area. The inn's restaurant serves mainly regional dishes. The location provides direct access to the hiking trail network in summer and to the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser in winter. Guests therefore use the Kasamandl both for active holidays and for relaxing stays in the Region Wilder Kaiser.
